name: MBSF 65+ Denominator File
description: Beneficiary-year denominator file for the predefined age 65+ Medicare population. Each row contains beneficiary identifiers, enrollment year, ZCTA/county/state geography, birth and death information, demographic codes, HMO/Medicare Advantage coverage, dual eligibility, buy-in coverage, entitlement reason codes, and derived disability and Fee-for-Service indicators. The 65+ file omits age_65plus_ind because all included beneficiaries are in the 65+ denominator population.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted beneficiary identifier (CCW Encrypted Beneficiary ID Number)
content.year: Int64: Calendar year of the enrollment record
content.zcta: String: ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) assigned from the beneficiary ZIP code
content.county: String: County FIPS code assigned from beneficiary geography
content.state: String: Two-letter state abbreviation assigned from beneficiary geography
content.dod: Date32[day]: Beneficiary date of death; null when no death date is recorded
content.age_dob: Int64: Age in years, calculated as enrollment year minus year of birth
content.yob: Int64: Year of birth extracted from date of birth
content.yod: Int64: Year of death extracted from date of death; null when no death date is recorded
content.sex: String: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values follow MBSF/ResDAC coding: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.race: String: SSA beneficiary race code from CMS enrollment data. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: String: RTI enhanced race and ethnicity code. The RTI algorithm improves Hispanic and Asian/Pacific Islander identification using SSA race plus first/last-name information. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.hmo: Int32: Medicare Advantage/HMO enrollment indicator; 1 = enrolled in HMO/Medicare Advantage, 0 = not enrolled
content.hmo_indicators: List[String]: Monthly HMO/Medicare Advantage enrollment indicators for the 12 months in the year
content.hmo_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with HMO/Medicare Advantage enrollment during the year
content.dual: Int32: Dual Medicare-Medicaid eligibility indicator; 1 = dual eligible in at least one month, 0 = not dual eligible
content.dual_indicators: List[String]: Monthly dual eligibility indicators for the 12 months in the year
content.dual_mo: Int32: Number of months with dual Medicare-Medicaid eligibility during the year
content.buyin: Int32: Medicare buy-in indicator; 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = no state buy-in months
content.buyin_indicators: List[String]: Monthly Medicare buy-in indicators for the 12 months in the year
content.buyin_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with Medicare buy-in coverage during the year
content.orec: String: Original reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = Both DIB and ESRD. The disability_ind field flags values 2 or 3 per this dataset's derived indicator logic.
content.curec: String: Current reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = Both DIB and ESRD, 4 = Part B Immunosuppressive Drug (PBID) entitlement when present in source data.
content.disability_ind: Int32: Disability entitlement indicator; 1 = original reason for entitlement (orec) is '2' or '3', 0 = otherwise
content.ffs_ind: Int32: Fee-for-Service eligibility indicator; 1 = hmo equals 0, 0 = enrolled in HMO/Medicare Advantage
